serverInfo.name: weftcut
serverInfo.title: WeftCut
serverInfo.description: The WeftCut desktop video editor exposed as an MCP tool surface. Tools, resources and prompts cover the full editing vocabulary: import and place clips, trim, split, keyframes with bezier easing, per-layer effect chains, chroma key, captions, Motif overlays, markers, checkpoints, undo and export. Calls land in the running editor's UI in real time, and the human audits the result in the app: Timeline diff lists what the agent added, removed or modified since the last approval, and Tacks are notes and questions the agent pins to time ranges for review. The version here is the release this card was last checked against; the running app reports its own in initialize.

transport.endpointNote: This server is not hosted. It runs inside the WeftCut desktop app, binds to loopback only, and picks a port at startup, so no fixed public endpoint exists. The recommended connection is the bundled weftcut-mcp stdio bridge, whose client config carries no port or token and survives app restarts, port changes and token rotation; this streamable HTTP endpoint is the direct fallback. The app's Settings -> Agent panel provides the ready-to-paste client config for either. Requests are bearer-authenticated and protected against DNS rebinding.

authentication.note: Per-install token generated by the app and shown in Settings -> Agent. There is no authorization server and no token endpoint to discover.
